# Words & Chords

(Moved from the root CLAUDE.md 2026-11-27.)

- Words & Chords (the carols / lyrics site, moved in 2026-10-31): one page `songs/index.qmd` draws every song (`?id=<slug>&prog=<programme>&ver=<version>`; no id = programmes + all songs, written into the page by the build so site search finds them). Few files on purpose (Cloudflare): data `apps/shared/data/songs.js` (all songs), page code `apps/shared/songs/song-page.js` (the carols site's keys / band / tap / MIDI pedal scripts, one block each); playback key: `window.SongKey` (Key menu in the Band panel, keys - and +, kept per song in localStorage `songs-key`; band + tune via BandPlayer `transpose`, chords over the words keep the written one in `data-orig`, staves by `visualTranspose`); two-bar lead-in under the section playing: `window.SongLeadIn` (drawn by the band on every song and by the video; on by default, Band panel / video box "Lead-in" turns it off, localStorage `songs-leadin`) + `songs.css`. Edit `scripts/songs/src/<slug>.cho` (ChordPro, format at the top of `scripts/songs/chordpro.py`) and `programmes.json` (`slug@Version` = students get that version of the changes; the teacher view, `?teacher=1` as for Works drafts, chooses any), then `python3 scripts/songs/build.py`; how-to `scripts/songs/HOWTO.md`. Tune Directory: Song rows and a Words & Chords list from `window.SONG_INDEX` (block between `songs:begin`/`songs:end` in works-data.js, written by the build). Test `node tests/songs/songs.cdp.js` (`NEG=1` must fail). Not moved yet: the Big Timestamp Player, the iReal charts and `carols.abc` (still in `~/Projects/carols`).
